asks: Can you see the whole of me yet?
Which way up am I, from there?
description: Somebody is standing here at several angles at once, opened out along creases that people don't have. Every panel of them is a view of the same person from a direction you aren't standing in.
emotes: {it} opens out one more panel, which wasn't previously part of the arrangement.
{it} refolds along a different set of creases and ends up the same size.
{it} turns, and every panel turns a different amount.
looks: The creases are sharp and well used, the way a map is that somebody actually navigates by.
One panel shows the back of their head. It's facing you, and so are they.
They fold shut briefly when you look away, and are open again by the time you look back.
name: a person unfolding like a map
says: It's all the same surface. You're only seeing more of it.
Folding is what people do. Most of you just do it once.
Don't try to put me back the way I was, you won't manage it.
